comments.SWAGameWorld>>tick: Clock 2: the simulation, every secondsPerTick (0.05 s). Knows nothing about rendering.
comments.SWAGameXR>>step:: Clock 1: every frame. Accumulates time, interpolates mobs, ticks the world every tickMillis.
comments.SWAGameXR>>adoptWorld:: Swapping a whole game goes through addDeferredFrameMessage:, between two frames.
comments.SWAGameXR>>buildMobAnimationData: Mob render entries are 11-slot Arrays, reused across ticks. Candidate for a real class.
comments.SWAGameSpace>>vectorForCellX:y:z:: The only cell to metre conversion. Mesher and game share this instance.
comments.SWAGameXR>>renderTerrainMeshOn:: Terrain first: drawMesh replaces the matrix the mob pass pushes.
comments.SWAGameVoxelChunks>>rebuildUpTo:: Clock 3: the mesher, at most chunkRebuildBudget chunks per frame.
